=== hello
        .text
        .globl  _main
_main:
        pushl   $msg
        call    _puts
        addl    $4, %esp
        xorl    %eax, %eax
        ret
        .section .rdata,"dr"
msg:    .asciz  "Hello from rsasm!"
=== data, bss and common
        .data
        .globl  _counter
_counter:
        .long   0
_table: .long   _f1, _f2, _counter
        .long   _f1 - _table
        .lcomm  _buf, 64
        .comm   _shared, 16
        .text
_f1:    movl    _buf, %eax
        ret
_f2:    movl    _shared+4, %eax
        ret
=== absolute and set symbols
        .globl  _abs
        _abs = 0x1000
        .text
        movl    $_abs, %eax
        .globl  _target
_target:
        ret
        .set    _alias, _target
        call    _alias
        .long   _alias
=== cross-section
        .text
        .globl  _code
_code:  movl    _thing, %eax
        call    _code
        jmp     _helper
_helper:
        ret
        .data
_thing: .long   _code, _helper, _stuff
        .section .rdata,"dr"
_stuff: .long   _thing - _stuff
        .long   _code - .
